# `sort_array`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Sorts the input array in ascending or descending order
according to the natural ordering of the array elements. NaN is greater than any non-NaN
elements for double/float type. Null elements will be placed at the beginning of the returned
array in ascending order or at the end of the returned array in descending order.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
sort_array(array[, ascendingOrder])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- sort_array, example 1
> SELECT sort_array(array('b', 'd', null, 'c', 'a'), true);
[null,"a","b","c","d"]
```

```sql
-- sort_array, example 2
> SELECT sort_array(array('b', 'd', null, 'c', 'a'), false);
["d","c","b","a",null]
```

## Version history
